title: Time the planning Nmax restore harness by stage and find why mixed-forest-Nmax is slow
outcome: Time the planning Nmax restore harness by stage and find why mixed-forest-Nmax is slow
acceptance: The stage responsible for mixed-forest-Nmax's wall time (15+ min versus independent-Nmax's ~87 s on the same host) is identified with measured evidence and either fixed or recorded with a bounded explanation
